_meta.title: Session 30 — DeepRare + AgingBench + SciMuse + Gemini-for-Science (7 user refs)
_meta.context: User-provided 7 unique links. (1) DeepRare (Nature 10097-9, SJTU+Xinhua+Harvard): agentic rare-disease diagnosis system — 2,919 diseases × 14 specialties × 7 public + 2 in-house datasets. HPO-based aggregate Recall@1 57.18% / R@3 65.25% (vs second-best Reasoning LLM 33.39/46.6). Per-dataset Recall@1 from Figure 2: RareBench-MME 78%, LIRICAL 58%, HMS 57%, RAMEDIS 73%, MIMIC-IV-Rare 29%, MyGene2 76%, DDD 48%. Multi-modal HPO+gene on Xinhua 168 cases: DeepRare R@1 69.1% vs Exomiser 55.9% (Hunan 162 cases: 63.6% vs 41.4%). Physician comparison on 163 cases vs 5 physicians (10+yr exp): DeepRare R@1 64.4% vs Physician 54.6%; 95.4% reasoning-chain agreement, Pearson 0.8689 ranking concordance. Baselines: Claude-3.7-Sonnet-thinking, DeepSeek-R1, Claude-3.7-Sonnet, PhenoBrain, Exomiser, DeepSeek-R1-Search. (2) AgingBench (arxiv 2605.26302 UT Austin): longitudinal benchmark foundation for Agent Lifespan Engineering (ALE). 4 aging mechanisms (compression/interference/revision/maintenance), 7 scenarios (S1 Research Lit, S2 Lifestyle, S3 KB, S4 SWE, S5 Self-Mgmt, S6 Naturalistic, S7 Self-Planning), 14 models × careful/lossy variants, ~400 runs across 8-200 sessions. (3) SciMuse (arxiv 2405.17044 Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light): knowledge-graph + GPT-4 research-idea generation. KG: 2.44M papers, 123,128 concepts, 58.5M paper-edges. 4,400+ ideas evaluated by 100 research group leaders. (4) Gemini for Science (Google I/O 2026 blog): AlphaEvolve (evolutionary coding agent), Antigravity with Science Skills (developer environment for scientific workflows). AlphaGenome + MedGemma already in DB. Non-ingestable refs: Nature 24-07487-w (auth redirect), wikidocs.net jaehong (403), biohub.ai/esm (minimal page; ESM-3 already in DB via evolutionaryscale/esm-3).
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. All DeepRare scores verbatim from paper Figures 1c/2a/3 + Tables in Methods. PhenoBrain/DS-R1-Search/Claude-3.7-Sonnet-thinking values read at sub-pixel from Figure 2a bar heights. AgingBench has no per-session-final numeric scores in main-text Figure 4 with sufficient precision; registered as benchmark family + new models only. SciMuse + AlphaEvolve + Antigravity registered as new models without point scores (system descriptions).

models.name: DeepRare
models._note: Agentic rare-disease diagnosis system. Multi-modal: HPO phenotype + clinical text + genetic variants. Hypothesis-Driven Reasoning with PubMed/OMIM/HPO/Orphanet retrieval. Tested on 2,919 diseases across 14 medical specialties × 7 public datasets (RareBench-MME/LIRICAL/HMS/RAMEDIS, MIMIC-IV-Rare, MyGene2, DDD) + 2 in-house cohorts (Xinhua Hospital 168 cases, Hunan Children's Hospital 162 cases). Nature 10097-9.

models.name: PhenoBrain
models._note: Specialized HPO-based rare disease ranking tool. Combines disease ontology with phenotype similarity. Used as classical baseline in DeepRare paper. Wang et al. 2022 + BGI updates.

models.name: PubCaseFinder
models._note: Phenotype-driven rare disease query tool combining HPO with PubMed case reports. NAR 2019 paper. Cited as baseline in DeepRare paper.

models.name: Exomiser
models._note: Gold-standard variant prioritization tool for rare-disease diagnosis. Combines phenotype + genotype scoring. Used as multimodal HPO+gene baseline in DeepRare paper Xinhua (R@1 55.9%) and Hunan (R@1 41.4%) evaluations.

models.name: MDAgents
models._note: Adaptive medical multi-agent framework with role-based collaboration. NeurIPS 2024 paper. Used as agent baseline in DeepRare (both GPT-4o and DeepSeek-V3 backbones tested).

models.name: MMedS-Llama 3
models._note: Medical small-language-model specialization of Llama 3 for multi-lingual medical Q&A. Used as biomedical-LLM baseline in DeepRare paper.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1 + RAG/Search
models._note: DeepSeek-R1 augmented with web-search/retrieval tools. Baseline variant in DeepRare paper RareBench evaluations. NOT identical to vanilla DeepSeek-R1 — separate strict-attribution model ID.

models.name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet (extended thinking)
models._note: Claude 3.7 Sonnet with extended thinking mode enabled. Used as Reasoning LLM baseline in DeepRare paper. Distinct ID from base claude-3.7-sonnet to preserve attribution to thinking-mode-specific scores.

models.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash (Fine-Tuned medical)
models._note: Gemini 2.0 Flash fine-tuned for medical rare-disease task. Baseline in DeepRare paper. Identifier preserves attribution to FT variant.

models.name: AgingBench (Lifespan Benchmark)
models._note: Longitudinal benchmark foundation for Agent Lifespan Engineering (ALE). NOT a single model — the benchmark itself is registered for downstream score attribution; SUT models (gpt-4o, gemma-4, qwen3, llama-3, ds-7b/14b, gpt-oss-120b) tested in careful/lossy memory-policy pairs.

models.name: SciMuse
models.vendor: Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light
models._note: Personalized research-idea generation pipeline. Knowledge graph: 2.44M papers from arXiv + bioRxiv (2018-2024), 123,128 concepts (manually curated by NSF), 58.5M paper edges. GPT-4 backbone scores 'novelty/impact/interest' via 16-feature graph-based prompt. 4,400+ research ideas evaluated by 100 research group leaders. Headline: Pearson 0.51 correlation between graph features and expert interest scores; top-quartile predictions achieve 86.7% expert ratings >=5/7.

models.name: AlphaEvolve
models._note: Evolutionary coding agent for mathematics + scientific discovery. Re-announced in Gemini for Science I/O 2026 with expanded scientific-domain coverage. Foundational result: discovered improved 4×4 matrix multiplication algorithms (Strassen-beating), Kissing-Number bound improvements, and 75+ open-problem improvements per published whitepaper.

models.name: Antigravity (Science Skills)
models._note: Antigravity agentic developer-environment with Science Skills add-on (Gemini for Science I/O 2026). Curated workflows for life-sciences + materials + math research integrated as model-callable skills. Distinct from base Antigravity model (workflow surface specialization).

benchmarks.name: AgingBench (Agent Lifespan)
benchmarks.description: Longitudinal benchmark foundation for Agent Lifespan Engineering (ALE). Measures HOW agents degrade (compression/interference/revision/maintenance) across 7 scenarios (S1 Research Lit, S2 Lifestyle, S3 Knowledge Base, S4 SWE, S5 Self-Mgmt, S6 Naturalistic, S7 Self-Planning). Headline = half-life t½ (sessions until 50% capability loss) — exact numeric values in Figure 4 not extractable at point-precision; benchmark family registered for future score ingest.

benchmarks.name: SciMuse — Graph-Feature ↔ Expert Interest

benchmarks.description: % of SciMuse top-quartile predicted ideas (by graph features) that received expert rating >=5/7. Headline of arxiv 2405.17044.
